environment.database: SQLite file, WAL, synchronous FULL, one server process
environment.client: separate Node process on same machine, loopback HTTP

concurrencyModel: 764 closed-loop tasks, one outstanding HTTP request each; no think time
mix: 50% new commands, 50% same-command retries; 5 new commands per match, fixed owner and distance
calculation: nearest-rank: sorted[ceil(p*N)-1], request start through JSON response including failures
limitations: Short finite local experiment; not open-loop, not WAN, no Unity physics, no PostgreSQL, no production capacity claim
